query.description:
(Required) PrivateAccess—Only members of the group can see posts to this group.
PublicAccess—All users within the community can see posts to this group.
Unlisted—Reserved for future use.
(Required) If the group is private, the “Information” section is visible only to members.
(Required) true if automatic archiving is turned off for the group, false otherwise. Defaults to false. If true, if there are no posts or comments for 90 days the group is archived.
(Required) true if only group owners and managers can create posts in the group, false otherwise.

info.name: Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 Abort Lists API

description.content:
Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 is a simplified, REST-based interface for bulk data operations that improves on the original Bulk API. It uses a straightforward job model and supports CSV format for ingest and query jobs, enabling processing of millions of records asynchronously.
